title: Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria

thread.title: Victoria of Many Faces • Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed the central character relationships, especially Victoria and Nonna’s bond and the gradual romantic warmth around Victoria.
Several commenters praised Nonna’s intelligence, independence, and distinctive personality.
Some viewers liked the episode’s direction and brisk presentation.
Commenters generally sympathized with the characters’ emotions but disagreed about whether Nonna’s decisions were believable or sensible.
Several commenters felt the episode forced drama and found parts of the conflict contrived or difficult to accept.
Some viewers criticized the pacing and felt the story was being rushed.
